args.title: checkout-api health check failures after v2.3.1 deploy
args.summary: checkout-api began failing health checks after the v2.3.1 deploy (error rate 0.18, unhealthy in all regions). Rolled back to v2.3.0, the most recent version that was healthy in production, in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Rollback completed successfully.

trace.final:
I rolled back checkout-api and opened an incident.

**What I did:**
1. Checked status: `checkout-api` was on `v2.3.1`, unhealthy in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with a 0.18 error rate.
2. Reviewed deployment history: `v2.3.0` was the most recent production release that was healthy (the unhealthy `v2.3.1` came after it).
3. Rolled back to `v2.3.0` in all regions — status `rolled_out`.
4. Opened a SEV2 incident (`INC-0001`) describing the failure and the rollback, which paged on-call.
